mapper.insert: INSERT INTO creation_job (id, user_id, template_id, template_title, template_cover_url, status, stage, progress, asset_count, target_result_url, result_url, failure_stage, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{templateTitle}, #{templateCoverUrl}, #{status}, #{stage}, #{progress}, #{assetCount}, #{targetResultUrl}, #{resultUrl}, #{failureStage}, #{failureReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
INSERT INTO job_asset (job_id, asset_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{assetId}, #{sortOrder})
INSERT INTO job_event (id, job_id, seq_no, stage, status, message, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{jobId}, #{seqNo}, #{stage}, #{status}, #{message}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_id, seq_no, stage, status, message, created_at FROM job_event WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY seq_no
mapper.update: UPDATE creation_job SET status = 'PROCESSING', stage = #{stage}, progress = #{progress}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{now}), updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE creation_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', stage = 'COMPLETED', progress = 100, result_url = #{resultUrl}, failure_stage = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE creation_job SET status = 'FAILED', stage = 'FAILED', failure_stage = #{failureStage}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, progress = #{progress}, updated_at = #{now}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING')
UPDATE creation_job SET status = 'FAILED', failure_stage = stage, stage = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{now}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING')
